map.→ 打开变形（监测/周期/分析）图表工具: -> Open the Deformation (monitoring / period / analysis) Chart tool
map.先查测站/记录，超限须重测相关边角，不可强行平差掩盖粗差。: Check the survey stations and records first; if a tolerance is exceeded you must remeasure the relevant edge and corner, and must not force a balance to hide a gross error.
map.变形监测周期分析图表工具：按周期录入监测点变形数据，绘制趋势图表并统计变化量，辅: Deformation monitoring period analysis chart tool: enter deformation data for monitoring points by period, draw trend charts, and compute the change, supporting engineering deformation monitoring and early warning.
map.平差前闭合差分配。: Distribute the closure error before balancing.
map.按规范限差判是否合格需重测。: If conformity must be judged against the specified tolerance, a remeasurement is required.
map.角度按 ±40″√n，坐标按等级（如 1/2000~1/10000），等级越高越: Angular tolerance follows ±40″√n, and coordinates follow the grade (such as 1/2000 to 1/10000), where a higher grade is stricter.
map.闭合差超限怎么办？: What If the Closure Error Exceeds the Limit?
map.附合/闭合导线算角度与坐标闭合差。: Compute the angular and coordinate closure errors of a traverse or closed traverse.
map.：闭合导线 n=4 站，理论 Σβ=360°，实测 359°59′20″ → 角: : A closed traverse with n=4 stations has a theoretical Σβ=360°, while the measured value is 359°59′20″, giving an angular closure error fβ=−40″; the tolerance is fβ_tol=±40″√n=±80″, so −40″ is within tolerance and can be distributed.
map.：闭合差 fx=0.05m、fy=−0.04m → f=√(0.05²+0.04: : With closure errors fx=0.05m and fy=−0.04m, f=√(0.05²+0.04²)=0.064m; the relative closure error = 0.064 / total traverse length, and meeting 1/2000 means it is qualified.
